messages.author: 1c36ae703fcd90c3
messages.subject: Multigroup with 4 groups, with a few questions not applicable to 2 of the groups
parts:
I have a questionnaire with 200 questions distributed to 4 groups of people, however, 10 of the questions were not applicable to 2 of the groups, I tried multigroup with all 4 groups together anyway (the 10 questions were set to NA) as would like to explore how it will look like.... it turns out those question without answers all return with the same a values,  but different d values. I am wondering why there are a and d values for NA items...

Also, does running multigroup in this way make senses? Or should I run two separate multigroups?

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Multigroup with 4 groups, with a few questions not applicable to 2 of the groups
parts:
Try searching through this forum first to see if you can find some code that helps. There are some constraints that you must apply in order to make the model identified for vertical scaling designs in multiple-group models. Should help you to understand how mirt deals with these types of data structures. Cheers.

Phil
